verdict.rationale: Skyvern's SDK connects to a cloud Chromium instance over CDP and layers Playwright on top, with AI commands added to Playwright and selector fallbacks. That suggests existing Playwright-style code can run against Skyvern's browsers. However, the evidence documents this only through Skyvern's own SDK. Missing for 10: a documented raw CDP/WebSocket endpoint that external Playwright or Puppeteer clients can connect to directly, any Puppeteer support, migration guidance for existing scripts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
